name: TapeAgents
summary: Agent framework built around structured replayable session tapes for debugging, resuming, serving and improving single agents or multi-agent teams.
description: Install tapeagents (PyPI 0.1.16; Python 3.10–3.12). Agents append thoughts, actions and control-flow steps; environments append observations to a structured Tape. TapeAgent Studio and TapeBrowser support debugging; revised tapes can inform configuration optimization and model fine-tuning. Provides streaming and examples for GAIA, data science and WorkArena. Apache-2.0 library; model credentials and compute are separate.

agent_access.notes: Local Python library: pip install tapeagents. Configure the selected LLM backend separately.
